corrections.name: Dragon Thunder
corrections.why: The repository previously encoded the site's Counter Skills category as the canonical class/subcategory. The dedicated skill page explicitly gives Attack Type Strike and Skill Type Super, while separately categorizing the move under Counter Skills. Under the repository taxonomy, counter behavior is a separate property and must not replace the canonical Super/Strike identity.
corrections.uncertainty: The dedicated page establishes 100 Ki, Strike Super, Omega Shenron, and CaC unavailability. No unlock method was established from the sources used, so it remains null.

notes: This correction preserves the prior identity and records the taxonomy reconciliation. The move remains represented as a Counter Skill conceptually, but its canonical identity is Super / Strike.
